en: The postcard displays a historical black-and-white image of a grand public square with a prominent ornate fountain (statue-topped), lush gardens, palm-like trees, well-dressed pedestrians, and large Neo-Renaissance style buildings in the background. The front text includes 'SUNDSVALL. VÅNGÅFVAN.' and handwritten greetings. The back side uses old-fashioned Swedish, with a green stamp and handwritten address lines.
